The institutional investor held 33,147 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.56M, down from 34,970 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wills Financial Group Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $928.18B market cap company.
